subject: english
question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

I admit that I did it **suddenly without thinking about it.**

options.text: Let the cat out of the bag
In the heat of the moment
Hit the nail on the head

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"suddenly without thinking about it"** means acting impulsively or without careful consideration. (बिना सोचे-समझे अचानक करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He apologized for his angry remarks, admitting that he spoke **suddenly without thinking about it.**
 
 
 
• **"In the heat of the moment"** refers to doing something impulsively or without thinking, often due to strong emotions. (भावनाओं में बहकर कुछ करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She regretted the harsh words she said **in the heat of the moment.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Kicked the bucket** (मर जाना): A slang phrase meaning to die.

 
 
• **Example:** Sadly, their beloved pet kicked the bucket last night.
 
 
 
• **Let the cat out of the bag** (राज़ खोल देना): To reveal a secret or disclose something that was supposed to be kept confidential.
 
 
• **Example:** She accidentally let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **Hit the nail on the head** (बिलकुल सही कहना): To describe exactly what is causing a situation or problem.
 
 
• **Example:** His comment about the budget issue really hit the nail on the head.
 
 

36:Tc9e,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
